title: A morphism of geometric points induces a bijection of etale stalks
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}k\to S$ and $\bar s':\operatorname{Spec}k'\to S$ be geometric points of $S$ [def-weil-geometric-point] ($k,k'$ algebraically closed fields). Let $a:\operatorname{Spec}k\to\operatorname{Spec}k'$ be a morphism of schemes with $\bar s'\circ a=\bar s$ (a *morphism of geometric points* $a:\bar s\to\bar s'$). For a pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u')$ of $\bar s'$ (an object $U\to S$ of the small etale site $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] with a lift $\bar u':\operatorname{Spec}k'\to U$ of $\bar s'$), $(U,\bar u'\circ a)$ is a pointed etale neighbourhood of $\bar s$. Then for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal F$ on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] there is exactly one map $a^*:\mathcal F_{\bar s'}\to\mathcal F_{\bar s}$ between the stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] sending the class of $\sigma\in\mathcal F(U)$ at $(U,\bar u')$ to the class of $\sigma$ at $(U,\bar u'\circ a)$, and $a^*$ is bijective; for a sheaf of abelian groups $\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] it is an isomorphism of abelian groups. (The functor $(U,\bar u')\mapsto(U,\bar u'\circ a)$ between the categories of pointed etale neighbourhoods is an equivalence.)

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Remark 04FN (etale-cohomology.tex 3416-3441; it only asserts the functor is 'clearly an equivalence'). Wrote the proof by agent in five steps: morphisms Spec K -> X as pairs (point, field map) with the composition rules (lem-weil-pbc-morphism-from-spec-field, lem-weil-pbc-residue-field-point-naturality, lem-weil-pbc-spec-field-point-residue-field), a = Spec(alpha) and precomposition with a injective; lifts of s-bar' / s-bar to U as kappa(s)-embeddings of kappa(u); bijectivity on objects from the separability (algebraicity) of kappa(u)/kappa(s) for etale U -> S (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-etale-residue-field-extension-separable) and the fact that an element algebraic over the algebraically closed alpha(k') lies in alpha(k') (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-algebraic-over-algebraically-closed-subfield); the functor is an isomorphism of categories (not just an equivalence); the stalk map is the comparison map of colimits along it, bijective, additive for abelian sheaves. Statement and stmt_deps kept; the clause about modules does not occur in Stacks 04FN (it speaks of 'stalk functors' only), the item's abelian clause is covered. lem-weil-pbc-etale-fibre-discrete-separable-points and lem-weil-pbc-etale-cover-geometric-point-lift were not needed.

lean.statement: theorem geometricPointMorphism_stalk_bijection {S : Scheme.{u}} {k k' : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] (s : Spec (.of k) ⟶ S) (s' : Spec (.of k') ⟶ S) (a : Spec (.of k) ⟶ Spec (.of k')) (ha : a ≫ s' = s) : let b : Over.mk s ⟶ Over.mk s' := Over.homMk a ha let α : (pointSmallEtale s').fiber ⟶ (pointSmallEtale s).fiber := Functor.whiskerLeft (Etale.forget S) (coyoneda.map b.op) (CategoryOfElements.map α).IsEquivalence ∧ (∀ F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (max u v)), let P := fun f : (pointSmallEtale s').sheafFiber.obj F → (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F ↦ ∀ (U : S.Etale) (t : (pointSmallEtale s').fiber.obj U) (σ : F.obj.obj (op U)), f ((pointSmallEtale s').toPresheafFiber U t F.obj σ) = (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber U (α.app U t) F.obj σ (∃! f, P f) ∧ ∀ f, P f → Function.Bijective f) ∧ (∀ F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{max u v}, let P := fun f : (pointSmallEtale s').sheafFiber.obj F ⟶ (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj F ↦ ∀ (U : S.Etale) (t : (pointSmallEtale s').fiber.obj U), (pointSmallEtale s').toPresheafFiber U t F.obj ≫ f = (pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber U (α.app U t) F.obj (∃! f, P f) ∧ ∀ f, P f → IsIso f)
